Replenishment Autopilot

Replenishment Autopilot is a paid add-on that writes Brightpath forecast quantities straight into your purchase order system every morning, so a planner approves a draft order instead of typing one. It costs $240 per month per warehouse on top of any Brightpath plan.

Request a trial

What it connects to

Autopilot writes to NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and any system that accepts a signed CSV drop. Setup takes two working days once credentials are in place.

What it costs

$240 per month per warehouse, billed with your Brightpath subscription. There is no setup fee and no minimum term. Full plan pricing is on the pricing page.

Who it suits

Autopilot suits teams already running Brightpath across three or more warehouses whose planners spend more than four hours a week re-keying replenishment quantities by hand.
